names.note: Read out of doxologia.ro's line for 17 martie.
Read out of saint.gr's line for 17 Μαρτίου, «Όσιος Αλέξιος ο άνθρωπος του Θεού», with the rank word left off.

Read out of the Ohrid Prologue's first heading for the Julian 17 March on pravoslavno.rs, „Свети Алексије Човек Божји.“, with Свети left off, which is not a rank. Човек Божји is kept: it is not a rank word but the by-name the heading gives him, the Man of God, and it is what this folder's English name already carries. A bare Алексије would fold with `alexis-of-moscow`.

Read out of the name link behind days.pravoslavie.ru's line for 17 марта ст. ст., «Преподобный Алексий, человек Божий», with the rank word left off. «человек Божий» is the by-name the calendar gives him and not a rank, so it stays; the day's own line gives the same words, declined.

death.note: doxologia.ro's life for the day: «Sfântul Alexie s-a mutat la cele veșnice în a șaisprezecea calendă a lui aprilie, adică la 17 martie, în anul de la facerea lumii 5919, iar de la întruparea Cuvântului lui Dumnezeu 411».

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 марта ст. ст. — «Прп. Алексия, человека Божия (411).»

attestations.note: The julian 17/3 is the same menologion day the other three calendars keep him on, and his name page lists no other. The year the line closes with, 411, is the year this folder already holds, and the calendar's longer reading gives the day with it: «погребены в храме во имя святого Вонифатия 17 марта 411 года», which is the day the calendar keeps him on. That reading also gives 1216 as the year his relics were found; no calendar read keeps him on it and it is recorded here only. The day page prints two troparia and a kondak for him, all three copied here. The calendar hangs two separate readings of his life on the same name page and they agree in substance.

source.text: doxologia.ro, calendarul zilei pentru 17 martie — «Sfântul Cuvios Alexie, omul lui Dumnezeu»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 17ης Μαρτίου — «Όσιος Αλέξιος ο άνθρωπος του Θεού»

attestations.note: «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 17 Μαρτίου εκάστου έτους.» The page gives no year of death — it places his birth at Rome «κατά τους χρόνους των αυτοκρατόρων Αρκαδίου (395 - 408 μ.Χ.) και Ονωρίου (395 - 423 μ.Χ.)» and nothing more, so the corpus's 411 from doxologia is left standing. It lists relics: the head at the monastery of Agia Lavra at Kalavryta, a portion of the head at the monastery of the Nativity of the Theotokos at Akraiphnio in Boeotia, and portions at Esphigmenou on the Holy Mountain, at Kykkos in Cyprus and at the Lavra of St Alexander Nevsky in St Petersburg.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 30.03.2026 (17. март ст. ст.) — „Свети Алексије Човек Божји.“

attestations.note: The day's first entry, on the same menologion day the Romanian and the Greek already keep in this folder, and the same man and the same story: the only son of a rich Roman, married and gone the same night, seventeen years a beggar at Edessa and seventeen more unrecognised in his father's own courtyard, the paper in his dead hand, the voice in the church. Its „17. марта 411. године“ agrees with the year this folder already holds from doxologia, to the day. It adds the reign of Honorius, the names of his parents, the image of the Lord Jesus at Edessa that was sent by the Lord himself to king Abgar, the ship driven past Laodicea to Rome, the thirty-four years his bride lived without him, the fragrant myrrh from his body, the coffin of marble and emerald, and his head in the Holy Lavra in the Peloponnese. Nothing in that was taken as a place: the entry names cities for his journeys and not one for a life lived in a single spot, and `locations` stays absent. The stored form keeps Човек Божји, which is not a rank but the by-name the heading itself gives him and the one this folder's English name already carries. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion; the three hymns here are the Romanian and Greek pages'.

hymns.text: Cu curgerile lacrimilor tale ai lucrat pustiul cel neroditor şi cu suspinurile cele dintru adânc ai făcut ostenelile tale însutit roditoare; şi te-ai făcut luminător lumii, strălucind cu minunile, Alexie, părintele nostru. Roagă-te lui Hristos Dumnezeu ca să mântuiască sufletele noastre.

source.text: Doxologia — Troparul Sfântului Cuvios Alexie, omul lui Dumnezeu

english.text: With the streams of thy tears thou didst till the barren desert, and with sighs from the depths thou didst make thy labours bear fruit a hundredfold; and thou becamest a light to the world, shining with wonders, O Alexis our father. Pray to Christ God that our souls may be saved.

hymns.text: Ἐκ ῥίζης ἐβλάστησας, περιφανοῦς καί κλεινῆς, ἐκ πόλεως ἤνθησας, βασιλικῆς καί λαμπρᾶς, Ἀλέξιε πάνσοφε· πάντων δ᾽ ὑπερφρονήσας, ὡς φθαρτῶν καί ῥεόντων, ἔσπευσας συναφθῆναι, τῷ Χριστῷ καί Δεσπότῃ. Αὐτόν οὖν ἐκδυσώπει ἀεί, ὑπέρ τῶν ψυχῶν ἡμῶν.

source.text: saint.gr — Ἀπολυτίκιον (Κατέβασμα), Ἦχος δ’, Ταχὺ προκατάλαβε, on the page of Όσιος Αλέξιος ο άνθρωπος του Θεού. It names him. The page prints a Μεγαλυνάριον, an Οἶκος and a Κάθισμα besides; only the apolytikion and the kontakion are taken here.

english.text: Thou didst spring from a root renowned and famous, and didst blossom from a city royal and splendid, O all-wise Alexis; and having thought lightly of all things as corruptible and passing away, thou didst hasten to be joined to Christ the Master. Entreat him therefore without ceasing for our souls.

hymns.text: Ἀλεξίου σήμερον τοῦ πανολβίου, ἑορτήν τήν πάνσεπτον, ἐπιτελοῦντες εὐσεβῶς, αὐτόν ὑμνήσωμεν λέγοντες· χαίροις Ὁσίων τερπνόν ἐγκαλλώπισμα.

source.text: saint.gr — Κοντάκιον, Ἦχος δ’, Ἐπεφάνης σήμερον, on the page of Όσιος Αλέξιος ο άνθρωπος του Θεού.

english.text: Keeping today with reverence the all-venerable feast of most blessed Alexis, let us hymn him and say: rejoice, thou delightful adornment of the venerable.

hymns.text: Возвысився на добродетель и ум очистив,/ к Желанному и Крайнему достигл еси,/ безстрастием же украсив житие твое,/ и пощение изрядное восприим совестию чистою,/ в молитвах яко безплотен пребывая,/ возсиял еси яко солнце в мире,/ преблаженне Алексие.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 марта ст. ст., «Тропарь преподобного Алексия, человека Божия», глас 4

english.text: Lifted up to virtue and having cleansed your mind, you reached him who is desired and is the last end; you adorned your life with freedom from passion, took up an exceptional fasting with a clean conscience, and kept to prayer as though you had no body. And so you shone like the sun in the world, most blessed Alexis.

hymns.text: Яко чистоты светильник пресветел показася,/ дивный Алексие,/ ибо тленный чертог/ на нетленное Божие Царствие пременив,/ яко целомудрил делатель преизряден./ Сего ради предстоиши Господеви, всех Царю./ Егоже моли, даровати нам мир и велию милость.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 марта ст. ст., «Ин тропарь преподобного Алексия, человека Божия», глас 4

english.text: You were shown to be a most radiant lamp of purity, wonderful Alexis, for you exchanged a bridal chamber that perishes for the imperishable Kingdom of God, as a most excellent workman of chastity. And so you stand before the Lord, the King of all; pray to him to give us peace and great mercy.

hymns.text: Дом родителей твоих, яко чужд, имев,/ водворился еси в нем нищеобразно/ и, по преставлении венец прием славы,/ дивен на земли явился еси, Алексие, человече Божий,// Ангелом и человеком радование.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 17 марта ст. ст., «Кондак преподобного Алексия человека Божия», глас 2

english.text: Holding your parents' house as a stranger's, you lodged in it in the likeness of a beggar; and when you had passed over and received the crown of glory you were shown wonderful upon the earth, Alexis, man of God, the gladness of angels and of men.
